name: Projected Interpolation Degree / Interpolation Degree
details: The full-domain projection is included in the defining maximum.
proof: Taking $S=\mathcal X$ in the definition gives $\mathrm{intdeg}^p(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal H)$.
witness_verification: For #classes/addressing with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs. The projected/order-shattering endpoint value uses its established finite-class equality with VC dimension.
